name: Glisan Akbari Super Speciality Hospital
role: Website planning, SEO direction & quality review
summary: A hospital website planned around departments, care topics, doctor information and a clear next step for visitors.
role_description: I planned the website and applied my digital marketing and SEO fundamentals. ChatGPT and Codex helped build it; I reviewed the output, identified issues and directed corrections.
context: Created as part of my work with the hospital.
goal: Help visitors understand the hospital’s services, find relevant doctor information and see how to take the next step. The structure connects departments with individual care topics and contact options.
decisions: Department pages connect to specific concerns, such as kidney stones. This gives visitors a route from a broad need to more relevant information.
Doctor details, consultation links and call options sit alongside service information, so visitors can see where to go next.
The department layout adapts from desktop to mobile. These are actual screenshots of the live site, with the mobile contact options visible.
seo_description: SEO is an ongoing part of this project. The reviewed pages already include descriptive titles, meta descriptions, headings and links between departments and services. Content and SEO refinement continue.
seo_note: This case study documents the website and my contribution. Traffic, ranking and enquiry results have not been measured for this case study.
